title: this is where I live
en: i love my home life however i've never considered the four walls in my one room to be the limit of my home this valley is just as much my living space as my little cottage and when the weather warms

and the spring breezes shiver the new growth of bunch grass my world expands no longer out of my reach due to winter storms it is a vast wilderness that is as endless as it is varied this week i wish to share a couple places that are close to my heart my home away from home if you will firstly it's this forest a secret location that i go to in order to collect supplies for my art projects i come here since it is untouched by other humans and therefore by using proper foraging

techniques the continuous abundance of nature is preserved this wood is thoroughly enchanted in my opinion and if you wandered through the trees until twilight no doubt you'd spy the dryads and fawns dancing in the shadows and whispering secrets to those who listen whatsoever enters this forest succumbs to the otherworldly atmosphere the white-tailed deer which are normally quite skittish are unafraid our shared respect for one another perhaps

creates that harmony as you have no doubt noticed the sprinkle of white on the forest floor is due to one of my favorite flowers it is known as the spring beauty the first to peek through the melting snow as early as march a gentle harbinger of the season of new life me
foreign so my home hosts a large variety of wild

growing plants and whenever i find something i can use or appreciate i'm ecstatic it is easy to go through your days without noticing these plants but when your soul is observant and curious suddenly they're everywhere as a connoisseur of herbal teas and all their unusual and wild forms today i decided to look for wild growing mint and mullen for future experimentation while the mullen took a little stroll to find i found the mint almost immediately all i had to do was follow my nose the scent is just about the most satisfying i know my quest for mullen finally achieved i

found myself next to the lake my other favorite place in my home there are a few sounds in which i find more contentment than the soft lapping of the lake against the bank i like to come here often and sit and watch it is incredible how nature has the ability to remind you of what's real in your life what is tactile not only what you can touch but feel so

brother and i worked hard on this one and we enjoyed the process very much sending my love you
zh: 我热爱我的家庭生活，但我从来没有认为我的一个房间的四堵墙是我家的限制，这个山谷就像我的小小屋一样是我的生活空间，当天气变暖时
春风颤抖着新长出来的草丛 我的世界不再因冬季暴风雨而扩展，这是一片广阔的荒野，一望无际，变化多端，这周我想分享几个贴近我心的地方，我的家外之家，如果你愿意的话，首先，这是这片森林，我去的一个秘密地点，为我的艺术项目收集物资，我来这里是因为它没有被其他人类接触过，因此通过适当的觅食
在我看来，这片森林是完全令人着迷的，如果你在树林中漫步直到黄昏，毫无疑问你会发现树妖和小鹿在阴影中跳舞，向那些倾听的人低声诉说秘密，无论什么进入这片森林的人都会屈服于超凡脱俗的气氛，通常很容易受惊的白尾鹿并不害怕我们对彼此的共同尊重
创造出这种和谐，因为你毫无疑问地注意到森林地面上的白色洒落是由于我最喜欢的花朵之一它被称为春天的美丽最早在三月就从融化的雪中窥视新生命季节的温柔预兆我
外国的，所以我家有很多野生的
种植植物，每当我发现一些我可以使用或欣赏的东西时，我都会欣喜若狂，很容易在没有注意到这些植物的情况下度过你的日子，但是当你的灵魂善于观察和好奇时，突然它们作为草药茶鉴赏家及其所有不寻常和野生的形式无处不在，今天我决定寻找野生生长的薄荷和马伦用于未来的实验，而马伦走了一小段路发现了薄荷，我几乎立刻就发现了薄荷，我所要做的就是跟随我的鼻子，气味几乎是最令人满意，我知道我对马伦的追求终于实现了
发现自己就在湖边，是我家中另一个最喜欢的地方，有一些声音比湖水拍打岸边的轻柔拍打声更让我满足，我喜欢经常来这里，坐下来观看，这真是令人难以置信，大自然有能力提醒你生活中的真实情况，触觉不仅是你能触摸到的，而且是你能感觉到的
外国的，我希望你喜欢这个视频，亲爱的
我和哥哥为这个项目付出了很多努力，我们非常享受这个过程，向你表达我的爱
